isolation: Each provider uses its own exact dependency lock and interpreter. Optional dependencies are not imported into the engine.

cpu.qualification: Measured operation and installed RECORD integrity passed on this host

cuda.qualification: Measured operation and installed RECORD integrity passed on NVIDIA RTX 5060 driver 591.74
cuda.device_binding: Exact NVIDIA UUID observed by driver inventory and PyTorch

directml.qualification: Measured numerical probe and all three RapidOCR model forwards passed on NVIDIA RTX 5060 driver 591.74
directml.device_binding: NVIDIA GPU UUID mapped through the CUDA driver to its exact DXGI LUID; AMD uses its exact boot-local DXGI LUID
directml.execution_evidence: Every RapidOCR model profile contains DirectML nodes; attributed CPU support nodes are counted separately

rocm.qualification: Conditional AMD Windows environment; no AMD hardware qualification on the development host
rocm.publisher_prerequisite: AMD-supported Windows 11 hardware and driver for ROCm 7.2.1; this recipe does not install or change a driver
rocm.device_binding: Exact runtime UUID required; unavailable identity prevents admission

measurement_limits: A small operation proves provider execution only for that operation, environment and device at the recorded time.
Full profile workloads require their own execution checks.

DXGI inventory does not provide global used VRAM, temperature or throttle status. These remain unavailable; the strict accelerator budget policy falls back to CPU until a supported telemetry source supplies all required measurements.
AMD SMI is a Linux interface; do not advertise it as measured native Windows telemetry.
ROCm and DirectML execution on AMD hardware has not been tested on this NVIDIA-only machine. DirectML execution on NVIDIA is measured separately from CUDA.
